rationale: v4 wins because Pre-action Self-Check (SC1-SC5), High-Risk Actions user-gate (10 items), machine-detectable Red Flags (RF1-RF11), Rationalizations rejection list (RT1-RT10), and honeypot self-check trap convert vague guardrails into checkable hard stops at +32% volume cost, the best enforcement-per-line ratio. v3 has the strongest integration schemas (JSON + ASCII flow + precedence table) but its +119% volume blowout (446 lines) crushes volume_efficiency to 0.30 and drags the aggregate below baseline. v2 is a solid runner-up with PII redact gate + Q0-Q10 fallback + stage-signal schema (+0.042), but v4's enforcement focus better matches the rubric's enforcement weight (0.20).
